_comment: Registry of optional plugins offered during setup. modrinth_slug must match the project slug at modrinth.com/plugin/<slug>. Add new entries here to extend the wizard - no code changes needed. 'requires' lists other plugin ids that will be silently force-installed as dependencies if this one is chosen.

plugins.name: Vault
plugins.question: Install Vault (economy/permissions API bridge, needed by many other plugins)?

plugins.name: EssentialsX
plugins.question: Install EssentialsX (homes, warps, kits, tpa, core commands)?

plugins.name: TAB
plugins.question: Install TAB and set a minimal tablist showing your server name (small caps)?

plugins.name: PlaceholderAPI
plugins.question: Install PlaceholderAPI (placeholder support used by TAB, Essentials, etc.)?

plugins.name: CoreProtect
plugins.question: Install CoreProtect (block logging & rollback anti-grief tool)?

plugins.name: ViaVersion
plugins.question: Install ViaVersion (let newer Minecraft clients join an older server version)?

plugins.name: Geyser
plugins.question: Install Geyser (allow Bedrock Edition players to join)?

plugins.name: Floodgate
plugins.question: Install Floodgate (lets Bedrock players join without a Java account, requires Geyser)?

plugins.name: spark
plugins.question: Install spark (performance profiler for diagnosing lag)?

plugins.name: Dynmap
plugins.question: Install Dynmap (live web map of your world)?
